stores.title: Store URLs or domains
stores.description: Shopify or WooCommerce stores, e.g. allbirds.com or https://shop.example.com. The platform is detected automatically.

maxProductsPerStore.title: Max products per store
maxProductsPerStore.description: Stop after this many products per store. Leave empty for the full catalog.

includeVariants.title: Include variants
includeVariants.description: Add the list of variants (SKU, barcode, price, stock, options) to each product.

onlyAvailable.title: Only in-stock products
onlyAvailable.description: Skip products that are sold out. Skipped products are not charged.

onlyOnSale.title: Only products on sale
onlyOnSale.description: Keep only products with a compare-at / regular price above the current price.

keyword.title: Keyword filter
keyword.description: Keep only products whose title, vendor, type, tags or categories contain this text (case-insensitive).

descriptionMaxLength.title: Max description length
descriptionMaxLength.description: Truncate the plain-text description to this many characters. 0 keeps the full text.

respectRobots.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobots.description: Skip product feeds that the store's robots.txt disallows.

concurrency.title: Stores in parallel
concurrency.description: How many stores to process at the same time. Pages within a store are fetched one by one.
